caption:
A Christmas gift you print, bind and wrap yourself. 🎄

It's 66 country Christmas scenes: snowy barns, farmhouse wreaths, vintage trucks hauling trees home. You pick one of the 23 printable covers, bind the pages, and it's ready for under the tree.

The line art's bold and open, so you can finish a page even if you're new to coloring, and there's enough detail to keep a seasoned colorist busy. US Letter 8.5 x 11 in, prints edge to edge. Hit print. It fits.

Link in bio 💛
altText: Four country Christmas coloring pages on a rustic wooden table: a vintage truck carrying a tree, a wagon piled with gifts, a woodpile by a log cabin and a candlelit window, with red plaid, pencils and dried orange slices.
